facts.situation: Robert and Jean Fletcher are joint clients with individual Holloway ISAs and a jointly held GIA. Jean has received a cleared inheritance of around £120,000 following her mother's death earlier in the spring; handle the bereavement sensitively. They want to invest the inheritance alongside their existing portfolio for long-term growth, with no portfolio income required for the foreseeable future. Both remain comfortable with risk profile 4 (moderate). The meeting valuation of the joint GIA was approximate. Jean could not recall the balance of her separate cash account or whether it remained active; the database records H-CASH-JE as open, with no value. That cash account is outside the report scope. The proposed new joint investment account does not yet exist and is therefore excluded from accounts_in_scope.

actions.action: Disinvest the existing joint GIA, H-GIA-JF, in full.
Apply Jean's cleared inheritance alongside the joint GIA proceeds to fund the agreed investments.
Top up Robert's ISA, H-ISA-R, for the new tax year.
Top up Jean's ISA, H-ISA-JE, for the new tax year.
Open a new jointly held investment account and invest the balance after the ISA top-ups.
